title: A uniform rectangular block has its center of gravity in the middle
summary: If a solid block is the same material all through, its center of gravity is at the middle of its length, width, and height.
body: NASA Glenn says that when mass is spread evenly, and the object has a line or plane of symmetry, the center of gravity lies on that symmetry. For a solid block of uniform material, the page says the center is simply the average of the physical dimensions. Its example is a rectangular block of 50 by 20 by 10, with the center at the point (25, 10, 5). The page was last updated 17 July 2024. A block whose material is denser on one side is the harder case the page says needs calculus.
